gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.
